portfolio.title: Selected Works
portfolio.subtitle: Recent Projects
portfolio.desc_crm-system: Built with a robust Client-Server architecture for high performance. The system features strict Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) ensuring data confidentiality, alongside full support for handling large datasets and efficient Excel export/import capabilities.
portfolio.desc_quran-audio-platform: A Progressive Web App (PWA) specifically designed and developed to play Quran recitations for Sheikh Dr. Ahmed El-Saeed Mandour with a modern, lightning-fast interface. It allows users to browse recitations categorized by year or location, featuring instant search and a seamless listening experience via a custom audio player. The system supports Natural Sort algorithms for Surahs, full offline capabilities, and buttery-smooth, lag-free transitions between Dark and Light themes.
portfolio.desc_dustout-platform: A comprehensive B2B & B2C e-commerce platform designed for supplying professional cleaning equipment. The project focuses on delivering an exceptional user experience through a modern interface featuring sleek Glassmorphism effects and engaging interactive animations. The platform offers lightning-fast browsing as a Single Page Application (SPA), alongside a secure and reliable management system for efficient data and order handling. It is fully responsive across all devices and perfectly optimized for Arabic (RTL) layouts.
portfolio.desc_supermarket-pos: A professional, comprehensive, and lightning-fast Desktop Application designed specifically for Point of Sale (POS) and store management. The system operates entirely offline to ensure maximum data security and speed. It seamlessly handles the complete business cycle—from cashier operations and inventory management to tracking client/supplier accounts, calculating shift earnings, and determining precise net profits, complete with direct thermal printer integration.
portfolio.desc_zamzam-system: A comprehensive, offline-first Desktop Application tailored for computer and electronics repair shops to digitize the entire repair workflow from device intake to handover. The system features a modern user interface, a robust ticketing system for precise status tracking, a dynamic analytics dashboard, and built-in invoice printing. Designed for high performance without internet dependency, it ensures maximum data security while offering one-click CSV database backups.
